svg.aria-label: Four ways to get the wrong answer with a good scope
svg.title: Four ways to get the wrong answer with a good scope

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1. Wrong reference plane

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Probing at the fixture output instead of the DUT's own pins moves the plane by the fixture's

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: loss and its stub.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: symptom: the eye looks better or worse by several dB, consistently

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. Unequalised measurement

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Measuring before the link's own equaliser has converged - or with the receiver's DFE switched

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: off - reports the channel, not the link.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: symptom: the eye is closed where the product's is open

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3. Too little analogue bandwidth

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A scope at less than twice the baud rate removes the high-frequency content that the mask exists

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: to constrain.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: symptom: jitter and rise time are flattered, the mask passes

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4. Pattern mismatch

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Running PRBS7 where the standard specifies PRBS31 skips the long runs that stress baseline

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: wander and AC coupling.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: symptom: a clean result on a link that fails in the field

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The common thread

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: None of these is an instrument fault. Each is a correct instrument answering a slightly different question than the standard asked,

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and each produces a number that looks entirely reasonable.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The defence is procedural: state the reference plane, state the pattern, state the equaliser state, and record the fixture's

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: de-embedding alongside the result. A margin with no provenance is not a margin.
